caseNameFull: Tennard v. Dretke, Director, Texas Department of Criminal Justice, Correctional Institutions Division

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed informa pauperis granted. Certiorari granted and consolidated with No. 02-11309, Smith v. Dretke, Director, Texas Department of Criminal Justice, Correctional institutions Division [certiorari granted, 539 U. S. 986], and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument in these cases.
